_help: Act 2, McKenna's tavern, gather rumours (one action): heard_isabelle_trouble (unlocks a way to recruit her), heard_americans_guns + heard_americans_boat (Acts 3 and 7), heard_first_expedition. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

start.speaker: mckenna
start.line: McKenna's. Cold beer and no questions. Well, you look like you've got questions.

choices.label: Ask about rivals
choices.line: Anyone else heading out into the desert?

choices.label: Ask about Akmentar
choices.line: Ever hear anyone talk about Akmentar?

mercs.speaker: mckenna
mercs.line: Idris Mahjoub, in the corner. Honest, for a gunman. And the Frenchwoman, Moreau. Best shot in Cairo, and three bounty men by the window waiting for her to leave.

rivals.speaker: mckenna
rivals.line: Yanks. Loud ones. Whitfield's lot have been buying rounds for the whole bar and hired four guns off the docks. Booked on the riverboat south, I hear.

akmentar.speaker: mckenna
akmentar.line: A fellow sat right there last year asking the same. One of Blackwood's men. Never came back for his change.
